cwe_descriptions: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') — The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment.
CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data — The product deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently ensuring that the resulting data will be valid.
